---
name: architecture-design
description: Produce a stack-aware architecture artifact from approved requirements and repository conventions.
---

# Architecture Design

1. Read approved requirements and inspect package manifests, source layout, and existing conventions.
2. Locate responsibilities without prescribing a framework absent from the repository.
3. Document components, data flow, API contracts, low-level design, risks, alternatives, and requirement traceability.
4. Add no dependency unless explicitly required or approved.
5. Write `docs/sdlc/<STORY-ID>/architecture.md` using the architecture template.
